description: Digitale Straßenkarte 1 : 10 000 (DSK10) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The historical DSK10 has been derived entirely from the Basic DLM (ATKIS) and the Automated Property Map ALK (Street Names) and has not been updated regularly. It is offered exclusively digitally. The state of Lower Saxony is covered by around 3,000 files. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Digital road map 1 : 10 000 (DSK10)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AdVMIS, GDIMRH. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
